(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 61 Mentre ch'i' rovinava in basso loco, 62 dinanzi a li occhi mi si fu offerto 63 chi per lungo silenzio parea fioco. Reference Translation (provided): While I was falling back to the low place, before mine eyes appeared one who through long silence seemed hoarse.

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST**
- **Line 61** *“Mentre ch'i' rovinava in basso loco,”* → **Locked Meaning**: A temporal circumstance in which *I* (the speaker) was moving downward toward a low location. - **Line 62** *“dinanzi a li occhi mi si fu offerto”* → **Locked Meaning**: An unspecified entity was presented *before my eyes*; the clause marks the sudden appearance of someone to the speaker. - **Line 63** *“chi per lungo silenzio parea fioco.”* → **Locked Meaning**: The appearing entity, after a long period of silence, *seemed hoarse/weak* (i.e., its voice was faint).
